items.headline: Microsoft Expands Use of Haivision Live Video Ecosystem
items.summary: Microsoft has selected Haivision's video transport and control solutions to support the production of over 600 global events annually.

items.headline: BlackRock Participates in Bajaj Finance Private Share Offering
items.summary: BlackRock, alongside other institutional investors, participated in a $1.2 billion private share offering by Bajaj Finance.

items.headline: BlackRock Discloses Voting Rights in Mercedes-Benz Group AG
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. filed a regulatory notification disclosing a change in its voting rights in Mercedes-Benz Group AG.

items.headline: NVIDIA Establishes National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee
items.summary: NVIDIA has formed a new board-level committee to oversee national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risk management.

items.headline: Microsoft Releases Preliminary Report on Recent 365 Service Outage
items.summary: Microsoft issued a preliminary post-incident report attributing the recent Microsoft 365 service disruption to a latent software defect and network capacity issues.

items.headline: Vertex Pharmaceuticals Officer Sells $8.37 Million in Common Stock
items.summary: Charles F. Wagner Jr., an officer at Vertex Pharmaceuticals, sold 15,300 shares of common stock valued at approximately $8.37 million.

items.headline: Teamsters Organize Rally for Terminated Amazon Delivery Drivers in New York City
items.summary: The Teamsters union is organizing a rally to support 200 delivery drivers who were dismissed after Amazon terminated its contract with their third-party employer.

items.headline: Instagram Launches Integration for Amazon Affiliate Links
items.summary: Instagram has introduced a new feature allowing creators to directly integrate Amazon affiliate links into Reels and feed posts.

items.headline: BlackRock Reports Change in Voting Rights in Smiths Group
items.summary: BlackRock, Inc. disclosed a reduction in its total voting rights in Smiths Group, moving from 12.97% to 12.61%.

items.headline: BlackRock Investment Institute Warns of Potential AI Buildout Slowdown Impact
items.summary: Jean Boivin, head of the BlackRock Investment Institute, highlighted the risk that a deceleration in AI infrastructure investment could have material consequences for U.S. economic growth.

items.headline: Amnesty International Reports Continued Labor Issues at Amazon Saudi Arabia Facilities
items.summary: Amnesty International has alleged that migrant workers at Amazon facilities in Saudi Arabia continue to face exploitation, including misleading recruitment practices and wage issues.

items.headline: Court Grants Intervention in Broadcom and VMware Legal Case
items.summary: The President of the Fourth Chamber of the General Court has granted the ACC leave to intervene in support of Broadcom and VMware in Case T-280/26.

items.headline: NVIDIA Announces Quantum Computing Collaborations with IBM and Fermilab
items.summary: NVIDIA is partnering with IBM and the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory to advance quantum computing research, including a new modular codesign platform and a high-speed decoding algorithm.

items.headline: NVIDIA Introduces Nemotron for Science Platform
items.summary: NVIDIA launched 'NVIDIA Nemotron for Science,' a new platform designed to help researchers build specialized AI agents for scientific discovery, including a new chemistry dataset.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley and UBS Upgrade Nucor Stock
items.summary: Morgan Stanley and UBS have both upgraded Nucor Corporation, reflecting positive sentiment from major financial institutions.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target on Parker-Hannifin to $1,050 From $1,038
items.summary: Morgan Stanley has updated its price target for Parker-Hannifin Corporation, increasing it from $1,038 to $1,050.

items.headline: Mondelez International to Sell French Bakery and Cereal Bar Businesses to Princes Group
items.summary: Mondelez International has agreed to sell its French bread substitutes and cereal bar businesses, including three manufacturing sites and four brands, to Princes Group for an enterprise value of €80 m

items.headline: Bernstein Downgrades PepsiCo to Underperform
items.summary: Bernstein has downgraded PepsiCo's stock rating from Outperform to Underperform, setting a new price target of $128.

items.headline: Mizuho Adjusts Price Target on Costco Wholesale to $1,150 From $1,100
items.summary: Mizuho has increased its price target for Costco Wholesale Corporation from $1,100 to $1,150.

items.headline: Piper Sandler Upgrades Medtronic to Overweight
items.summary: Piper Sandler has upgraded Medtronic's stock rating to Overweight from Neutral, setting a price target of $120.

items.headline: Medtronic Receives FDA Clearance for Hugo™ Robotic-Assisted Surgery System in General Surgery
items.summary: Medtronic has secured FDA clearance to expand the use of its Hugo™ robotic-assisted surgery system to include general surgery procedures.

items.headline: Chevron Nears $5 Billion Deal for Stake in Blackstone-Backed Oil Field
items.summary: Chevron is reportedly close to a $5 billion agreement to acquire a majority stake in an oil field in the Gulf of Mexico that is currently supported by Blackstone.

items.headline: Berenberg Adjusts Price Target on Air Products and Chemicals to $365 From $355
items.summary: Berenberg has updated its price target for Air Products and Chemicals, raising it to $365 from $355 while maintaining a Buy rating.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs Issues Gold Price Forecast for 2027
items.summary: Goldman Sachs analysts project gold prices to reach $4,650 per troy ounce by the end of 2027.

items.headline: Citigroup Adjusts Price Target on T-Mobile US to $185 From $165
items.summary: Citigroup has updated its price target for T-Mobile US, raising it from $165 to $185.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs Adjusts Price Target for Tyson Foods
items.summary: Goldman Sachs has updated its price target for Tyson Foods, Inc. from $62 to $70.

items.headline: Goldman Sachs Participates in Bajaj Finance Share Offering
items.summary: Goldman Sachs, alongside BlackRock and Nomura, has invested in a share offering by Bajaj Finance.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target on Allstate to $275 From $260
items.summary: Morgan Stanley has increased its price target for The Allstate Corporation, moving it from $260 to $275.

items.headline: Bernstein Adjusts Price Target on Constellation Energy to $293 From $296
items.summary: Bernstein has revised its price target for Constellation Energy Corporation, lowering it from $296 to $293.

items.headline: Jefferies Adjusts Price Target on Newmont to $149 From $155
items.summary: Investment firm Jefferies has revised its price target for Newmont Corporation, lowering it from $155 to $149.

items.headline: Waste Management, Inc. Declares Quarterly Cash Dividend
items.summary: Waste Management, Inc. has announced its quarterly cash dividend of $0.945 per share, payable on December 18, 2026.

items.headline: Nvidia Reduces Stake in Intel Corporation
items.summary: Nvidia has disclosed a reduction in its investment stake in Intel Corporation, as revealed in recent regulatory filings.

items.headline: The Home Depot Announces Executive Leadership Changes
items.summary: The Home Depot has appointed Richard McPhail as CEO, Ann-Marie Campbell as President and COO, and Jordan Broggi as CFO, effective November 23, 2026.

items.headline: Berkshire Hathaway Increases Stake in Delta Air Lines
items.summary: Regulatory filings reveal that Berkshire Hathaway increased its investment in Delta Air Lines by approximately 12.44% during the third quarter of 2026.

items.headline: The Home Depot Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: The Home Depot reported third-quarter 2026 sales of $43.4 billion, representing a 4.9% increase compared to the same period in 2025.

items.headline: Barclays Adjusts Price Target on Regeneron Pharmaceuticals to $1,075 From $917
items.summary: Barclays has increased its price target for Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, reflecting a positive adjustment in its valuation outlook for the company.

items.headline: JPMorgan Adjusts Price Target on Moderna to $102 From $77
items.summary: JPMorgan has updated its price target for Moderna, Inc., raising it to $102 from $77.

items.headline: Morgan Stanley Adjusts Price Target on Moderna to $200 From $95
items.summary: Morgan Stanley has significantly increased its price target for Moderna, Inc. to $200 from the previous target of $95.

items.headline: Mizuho Adjusts Price Target on Aflac to $118 From $117
items.summary: Mizuho Securities has updated its price target for Aflac Incorporated, raising it to $118 from the previous target of $117.

items.headline: Autodesk and Neilsoft Announce Strategic Partnership for New Centre of Excellence in India
items.summary: Autodesk and Neilsoft Limited have partnered to launch a Centre of Excellence (COE) in Pune, India, focused on advancing BIM and Digital Twin technologies for the AECO industry.
